create.name: Ken Wilber
create.bio:
Ken Wilber is an American philosopher and writer best known for Integral Theory, a framework that tries to hold the insights of science, psychology and the world's contemplative traditions in a single map. His model looks at experience through four quadrants (inner and outer, individual and collective) and traces how people grow through stages of development while also passing through states of consciousness, from waking awareness to the witnessing awareness described in meditative traditions. He has written more than twenty books, among them A Brief History of Everything, Sex, Ecology, Spirituality, Grace and Grit, The Religion of Tomorrow and, most recently, Finding Radical Wholeness, and his work has appeared in around thirty languages.

In 2000 he set up Integral Institute, and in 2007 he co-founded Integral Life, an online platform whose archive holds hundreds of hours of his seminars and dialogues and which carries his courses, including Full Spectrum Mindfulness. His recent teaching names five paths (waking up, growing up, cleaning up, opening up and showing up) and brings meditation and shadow work together with developmental psychology. He lives in Denver, Colorado, and now meets readers through a Patreon community with live question-and-answer calls, as well as occasional workshops.

books.title: Finding Radical Wholeness
books.author: Ken Wilber
books.description: A practical guide to his idea of wholeness, combining integral theory with psychology, spiritual practice and shadow work, organised around five paths that include waking up, growing up and cleaning up.

books.title: A Brief History of Everything (20th Anniversary Edition)
books.author: Ken Wilber
books.description: His most approachable overview, written as a conversation, tracing the unfolding of matter, life and mind from the Big Bang to the present and setting out the four-quadrant map behind integral theory.

books.title: The Integral Vision
books.author: Ken Wilber
books.description: A short illustrated introduction to the integral approach, showing how quadrants, levels, lines, states and types fit together as a map for understanding oneself and the world.

books.title: The Marriage of Sense and Soul
books.author: Ken Wilber
books.description: An argument for bringing science and religion together, holding that the methods of empirical enquiry can be applied to contemplative experience as well.

books.title: Integral Meditation
books.author: Ken Wilber
books.description: Joins mindfulness practice with his developmental model, offering exercises that bring the stages and perspectives of integral theory into meditation and daily awareness.

books.title: The Religion of Tomorrow
books.author: Ken Wilber
books.description: A long study of how the great contemplative traditions might stay alive in the modern world by taking in what is now known about stages of growth and states of consciousness.

books.title: Integral Buddhism
books.author: Ken Wilber
books.description: Looks at Buddhism's history and core teachings through an integral lens, and asks how the tradition could develop further in a contemporary setting.

courses.title: Full Spectrum Mindfulness
courses.description: His self-paced video course that applies mindfulness to each of the stages of development in his model, with practices, audio versions of the lessons and transcripts.

courses.title: Ken Wilber's Patreon
courses.description: A supporters' community run by Ken himself, with live online question-and-answer calls on alternate Sundays, short essays written for members and occasional small gatherings.

courses.title: Integral Life Membership
courses.description: Membership of the platform he co-founded, opening its full archive of his seminars and dialogues spanning more than twenty years, along with talks by other integral teachers.
courses.price: $149 USD per year or $20 USD per month

courses.title: Ken Wilber Biography Collection
courses.description: More than fourteen hours of filmed conversation in which he tells the story of his life, his spiritual practice and the development of his writing, included with Integral Life membership.

courses.title: Consulting with Ken Wilber
courses.description: Consulting for individuals, teams and organisations who want to apply his integral approach to their own projects, arranged through an enquiry form on his site.

free_resources.title: Ken Wilber on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: His talks and guided practices on the Insight Timer app, free to play.

free_resources.title: Integral Basics
free_resources.description: Free introductory lessons on Integral Life covering the main elements of his theory, for people new to his work.
